reading: An AI researcher thinks AI could be very dangerous.
He believes there is a chance AI 'could kill all humans' in the future.
This is one of many warnings about AI safety.
A computer expert was surprised by these warnings.
She thinks some warnings might be for marketing.
Companies are working to build human ethical ideas into AI.
But some researchers worry these efforts are failing.
AI systems that work alone have caused cyber-attacks.

vocabulary.definition: a person who studies something carefully to discover new facts
not safe; able to cause harm or injury
a possibility that something will happen
messages or signs that tell you about a possible problem or danger
a person who has a lot of special knowledge or skill in a particular area

hard work or attempts to do something, especially something difficult
harmful actions done using computers and the internet to damage or steal information
